notices: Using wildcard characters when filtering log messages
Disk logging disabled by default on some models
Upgrading from FortiOS version 5.0.10 or later
Upgrading from FortiOS version 4.3.16 or later

observations.description: Corruption handling by the AV-Engine and AV Database may not work as expected.
DLP and virus scan of attachments for on-premises version of OWA may not work as expected.
capwap for MAC lookup in Cluster Mode may not work as expected.
After rebooting backup box, fips-cc vpn config test failure may occur.
If the response code is not 200, the Connection Upgrade Case Proxy may bypass the session.
In SGMII mode, users may not be able to program the SFP.
The Blade may stop passing traffic and restarts unexpectedly.
When there is a license status change or a warning occurs, the FortiGate-VM License Alert may not appear in the Event Log.
The FSSO may drop users before retrieving the complete list.
The Network Interface page may display incorrectly.
Users may still be able to delete Firewall Policies in Read Only Mode.
In some cases, the Top Sources widget may only report traffic only for root VDOM.
The TCP session may not clear on a-p slave.
After a default timeout expiration occurs, the session duration timer on the slave may reset.
HA Packet loss may occur when there is high CPU usage
The hasync may stop synchronizing the configuration if the file descriptor is exhausted.
When editing the default admin account in the CLI, it may not sync in the HA envir-onment.
The debugzone and checksum under the HA checksum may not match.
After a vcluster1 failover, the vcluster2 VMAC on the VLAN interface may not persist.
Tunnels may go down after 420 days of uptime.
When handling IKEv2 SA_INIT Packet as a Responder, the iked may stop working.
A memory leak may occur in the SMB2 decoder.
unknown-0 interface may be displayed in the log.
After a HA failover with multiple ISPs, the FortiAnalyzer logging over IPSec may stop working.
When the Source is a FortiAnalyzer, Traffic Logs may not be displayed.
If OSPF type 3 routes are obtained from multiple ABRs, some of the routes may not be installed after selected ABR flushes its type 3 routes.
After sslvpn idle-timeout expire and portal re-login occurs, the RDPnative may not work.
After sslvpn idle-timeout expire and portal re-login occurs, the RDPnative may not work.
When a website is accessed through the SSLVPN Web Mode Bookmark, users may not be able to upload files.
Due to VDOM isolation, the System Admin remote group may be modified incor-rectly.
10G full speed option may not be available for FortiGate-1500D.
HTTPS Transactions may not work.
When there is a null trusthost betwen the valid trusthosts, the Admin User may not be able to login to the FortiGate.
Due to ARP Requests and NP Accelerated Sessions, high CPU usage may occur.
When trying to obtain the Admin Profile from Radius, the SCP backup may not work as expected.
When users try to edit the Display Zone from the GUI, the Display Zone with the Mem-ber Interface List may be slow to load.

There may not be a corresponding policy for the keepalive portal, and the redir-ect address may be set to the local IP. This may cause the location.href to be the IP address instead of the auth-redirect-addr thatis configured in the policy.
AV-Engine and AV Database corruption handling may occur.
During bootup, the System and Console may be slow to respond.
Application Control and IPS UTM Profiles may be limited to only 500.
Application Control and IPS UTM Profiles may be limited to only 500.
In some cases, the Radius Authentication may not work.
When the Webcache is enabled and it receives the 304 Message from the Server, the wad process may stop working.
When going through two Explicit Proxies, the None Standard HTTPS Page may not load as expected.
In some cases, the URLFilter may become stuck in the No Correct FortiGuard Information state.
After upgrading to 5.0, the HA Cluster may be out of sync.
After upgrading from 4.3 to 5.0, the TCP Reset Settings may have changed.
After upgrading to 5.0.11 or 5.2.3, the Explicit Proxy Service may not be correctly cre-ated when using the GUI.
The link and speed LEDs remain on after shutting down the unit using the execute shutdown command.
The r8168 driver is unable to shutdown power of the port and will keep the link of the other end in an up state.
IP tunneling (SIT tunneling) does not work when offloaded to NP6.
observations.workaround: Disable auto-asic-offload in SIT tunnel configurations.

observations.description: FG-3700D: LAG groups configured on low latency interfaces (port25 to port32, and NP6_0 to NP6_1) do not function correctly.
observations.workaround: Only use either low-latency-mode or LAG for traffic on these interfaces.

observations.description: Reply traffic is not offloaded when shared traffic shaping is enabled on policies for accelerated inter-VDOM links using the npu_vdom interface.
Traffic may not pass through a VLAN interface added to a link aggregation group (LAG) in a transparent mode VDOM.
observations.workaround: Run a diagnose sniffer packet on the physical interface in the transparent mode VDOM or reboot the FortiGate unit.

observations.description: IPsec VPN traffic throughput is highly unstable.
observations.workaround: Do not use IPsec VPN over a 40G LAG.

observations.description: When the FortiGate unit experiences high CPU usage, IPsec VPN packets may be lost.
A firewall policy may be deleted after a reboot if it uses an empty FSSO group.
When using Microsoft Internet Explorer 9, created firewall policies are not displayed in the Policy page. The content pane toolbar is not displayed in this page.
After enabling capability-default-originate, BGP will not insert the default route learnt from a different neighbor.
The initXXX daemon may cause high CPU usage.
Antivirus profile errors after upgrade from 4.3
The source address is lost and SNAT is disabled in a multicast policy after upgrading from 4.3.
When upgrading from 4.0 to 5.0 firmware, the LB VIP option set http-ip-header enable may not be preserved.
Users may not be able to upgrade to 5.0.12 due to the impact of the VIPs no longer working when making requests internally to the external IP addresses.
